How small clinics pay for scheduling software

In a survey of 412 independent clinics conducted in March 2026, 61 percent said they already pay a monthly subscription for appointment scheduling software.

Clinics with fewer than five practitioners reported a median spend of 89 dollars per month on scheduling tools, and most said price was less important than reliability.

Respondents who had trialled a paid pilot were twice as likely to sign an annual contract as those who had only used a free trial.
